predecessors.name: East Francia
predecessors.text: the Main valley from the Rhine to the Nordgau, with the left-bank Gaue around Mainz, Speyer and Worms; Hesse (Hessengau, Lahngau) to the north

successors.name: Kingdom of Germany
successors.text: the Main valley from the Rhine to the Nordgau, with the left-bank Gaue around Mainz, Speyer and Worms; Hesse (Hessengau, Lahngau) to the north

ledger.x: 906: Conrad the Younger is mentioned as dux Franconiae and the infobox dates the duchy's foundation.
918: Eberhard succeeds his brother Conrad I as duke of Franconia in December 918, after the king's death; in 919 the Saxon Henry the Fowler succeeded Conrad as king.
938: Duke Eberhard rebels against Otto I.
939: the rebels are defeated at Andernach.
939: Otto I seizes Franconia and appoints no new duke.

wars.name: Eberhard's revolt against Otto I
wars.outcome: Eberhard rebelled in 938 with Thankmar, again in 939 with Gilbert of Lorraine, Archbishop Frederick of Mainz and Henry; the rebels lost at Andernach on 2 October 939 and Otto seized the duchy.

certainty.note: The pages define the duchy by the Main valley and its Gaue; the Eberhard page says it 'does not define the duchy's boundaries'.
